overview.lead: Global capability building and startup acceleration, from Silicon Valley
paragraphs: Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Odyssey Ventures, LLC was founded in 2018 as a specialist in capability-building education for global markets and startup acceleration. We design and run hands-on education programs for public institutions, startups and universities, along with acceleration programs that help startups expand globally, providing practical and structured solutions for entering overseas markets and strengthening global competitiveness.

Odyssey Ventures launched its startup acceleration business in earnest in 2024. Building on our founder's and team's years of experience mentoring and growing startups, and on our wide network across Silicon Valley, we run both partner programs and our own programs.

facts.label: Business
facts.value: Startup acceleration, corporate education and consulting

items: Founded GlobalLeadersCamp, LLC (San Jose, CA), starting as a corporate leadership consulting company
Renamed to Odyssey Ventures, LLC and launched the startup acceleration business in earnest
Ran the Global Product Academy (Design Thinking, Product Management, Program Management)
Planned and ran the Hanyang University global meetup program
Ran the KIC DC Tech Frontier_Startup Talk & Mixer program
Ran the KIRO robot startup global meetup program
Ran the Silicon Valley Accelerator Around-X Program & K-Global Program Networking Event
Planned and ran the Mobility Matters business meetup
Delivered the 2025 KSC Silicon Valley onlanding program brokerage service
Recruiting the first cohort of the 2026 Odyssey U.S. Expansion Support Program

aboutPage.expertsDescription: Odyssey Ventures brings together experts with deep hands-on experience in product design, product management, program management and marketing in Silicon Valley.

12 years of startup mentoring and consulting; 3 years of acceleration
